title: finding(core): `formatTitleTemplate` treats a whitespace-only placeholder value as resolved, so `{contract_no} - {name}` with a blank-looking `name` renders `HT-2026-003 -` on every resolver-backed surface
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a measurement. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it. The site is `packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts`: `formatTitleTemplate`.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10360 (PR objectui#10443, class a). The contract review of that PR confirmed it at source. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

`formatTitleTemplate` tests a placeholder's value with `value === null || value === undefined || value === ''`. A whitespace-only value, such as three spaces, therefore counts as RESOLVED and is emitted. The later whitespace collapse and trim then leave the separator dangling. `recordDisplayValueAt`, the objectui#8350 emptiness authority, trims and returns `undefined` for the same value. So the two disagree on what "empty" means.

## Measured

The objectui#10360 dev probed `packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts` with `{contract_no} - {name}`, `contract_no: 'HT-2026-003'` and `name` set to three spaces:
- `formatTitleTemplate` renders `HT-2026-003 -`.
- `getRecordDisplayName` returns `HT-2026-003 -`, so every surface backed by that resolver shows the dangling separator.
- On the record page, the header's own `cleanupTitleSeparators` shows the H1 as `HT-2026-003`, while `record:details` still prints the Contract No row. That was measured rendering the real `page:header` beside `record:details`.

It is reachable on `main` today. It predates objectui#10443, which leaves `record-title.ts` unchanged.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The fix shape: judge a placeholder empty the way `recordDisplayValueAt` does (trim, then empty), so the renderer and the emptiness authority agree. Pin: a whitespace-only placeholder drops with its separator, and a real value is unchanged.
- ADR-0079 deprecates `titleFormat`, but `getRecordDisplayName` still reads it as a rung, and many surfaces show that.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items, pattern `formatTitleTemplate` near whitespace / blank / trim / dangling / separator, `whitespace-only placeholder`, or `dangling separator` ⇒ 0 hits. The control `formatTitleTemplate` ⇒ objectui#10434, so the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `formatTitleTemplate whitespace-only placeholder` · `titleFormat dangling separator blank field` · `getRecordDisplayName trailing separator whitespace`
